gen-gf-sniglet-gf-noto-sans-cypro-minoan: Distinctive from the first glance, Sniglet has soft, blunt endings that never curl back in. Noto Cypro Minoan is not the name, so: Noto Sans Cypro Minoan is a plain sans with cut-back terminals, and a slightly larger size gives its gaps room.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-noto-sans-hanifi-rohin: Approachable and modern, Noto Sans Hanifi Rohingya has a c that gapes wide at any size. Sniglet sits above it with chunky arches on its r, n and m that match the stems, and the two feel like friendly neighbors across a long page.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-noto-sans-hatran: Sniglet looks cut out with a router bit, every stroke a uniform chunky channel. And Noto Sans Hatran, a plain sans with a funnel-wide e, makes the whole pairing feel approachable.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-noto-sans-inscriptiona: Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi reads crisp, with small counters that never clog. Sniglet's crossbars match its stems in thickness, so the heavy heading and the lighter sans-serif text sit together without any fuss.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-noto-sans-javanese: Sniglet draws every character with a marker-like plainness, soft at the ends and blunt throughout. And Noto Sans Javanese, a sans-serif with connected, open counters, gives that rounded weight a lighter, cleaner partner underneath.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-noto-sans-kawi: Round, blunt, utterly uniform. Sniglet has no stroke contrast at all, and Noto Sans Kawi, a sans-serif with an open-jawed c like pliers, makes that difference the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-noto-sans-linear-a: Sniglet has a blunt round-tip marker feel from end to end, with terminals that stop short of curling. And Noto Sans Linear A, a sans-serif with a visibly gaping c, makes the strongest quality of the pair its lightness against that heft.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-noto-sans-linear-b: Noto Sans Linear B reads smooth, with a clear path around every bend. Sniglet, drawn like bent rope or tubing, gives the pair its strongest quality: a heavy, tubular heading above a light, modern sans-serif.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-noto-sans-manichaean: Sniglet's crossbars are as thick as its stems, which gives it a chunky, tubelike look. Noto Sans Manichaean, a sans-serif with open-mouthed e crossbars, supplies the lighter, cleaner counterweight that makes the pair strongest.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-noto-sans-mongolian: Noto Sans Mongolian reads neutral and modern, its terminals flaring outward. Sniglet's n arches are as thick as the stems beside them, and so it carries the heading's weight while the sans handles the text.
